# Temple Scroll Column 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 6 | **Condition:** Heavily damaged to fragmentary; Festival of New Wine

---

**6:1** [...] after [the Harvest Festival ...] you are to begin counting [...]

**6:2** [...] from the day you presented the new grain offering [...]

**6:3** [...] seven weeks [...] seven full [weeks ...]

**6:4** [...] until the day after the seventh week, continue counting [...]

**6:5** [...] fifty days [...]

**6:6** [...] then bring freshly pressed wine as a drink offering [...]

**6:7** [...] new wine [...] present it as an offering [...]

**6:8** [...] pour out the new wine as a drink offering on the altar [...]

**6:9** [...] the priests will present their offering first [...] then the Levites [...] and then all the people of Israel [...]

**6:10** [...] celebrate with joy in the presence of the LORD your God [...]

**6:11** [...] this is a permanent law for all generations, wherever you live [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 6 introduces the Festival of New Wine — a celebration unique to the Temple Scroll with no Pentateuchal parallel. Falling fifty days after the Harvest Festival (Weeks), it extends the first-fruits principle to wine. The hierarchical offering order (priests, Levites, laity) reflects the scroll's priestly vision. "Freshly pressed wine" makes tirosh vivid for modern readers.*
